title: IGLUE: A Benchmark for Transfer Learning across Modalities, Tasks, and Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot cross-lingual transfer performance of vision-and-language models across 20 diverse languages to measure the 'Anglo-centric bias' and performance gaps (transfer gap) between English and target languages.

Using the MaRVL (Multicultural Reasoning over Vision and Language) dataset to test model reasoning over culturally specific concepts and culturally relevant images annotated by native speakers, measuring performance drops in out-of-distribution cultural contexts.
